suites.sample_design: 1,000 tables per split; 500 mechanisms per split; two independently sampled tables per mechanism; all 2,000 evaluations completed.

suites.generator_scope: Published simulation mechanisms adapted to a complete-data NIE₁ target, removing some source treatment-induced confounding or missingness. Properties describe the adapted generators, not unchanged original-paper tasks.
suites.variance_note: The report publishes empirical SE, defined as the square root of mean within-mechanism sampling variance (weighted for Table 1). Variance ≈ (reported SE)² is a display conversion from rounded values, not an exact raw variance. Original SE is retained in the data download and cell tooltip.
suites.variance_definition: Weighted mean within-mechanism sampling variance, approximated by squaring rounded report SE; not cross-table error variance.
suites.coverage_note: Nominal coverage is 95%. Mechanism-clustered Monte Carlo SE: 0.66 percentage points (ID) and 0.45 percentage points (Source-OOD). Each mechanism has only two repeated tables; estimated within-mechanism variance is consequently noisy.
suites.comparison_note: The report does not contain Random Forest accuracy or interval metrics for this meeting run. Its main-table entries are explicitly not reported, not zero. The earlier paired CPU comparison uses a previous model and test set.
suites.context_note: MediPFN current-run results. Random Forest accuracy metrics for this run are not reported; its previous-model CPU comparison is displayed separately.

suites.label: ATE · collected DGP evaluation

source.title: ATE and CATE Evaluation — Using Our Collected DGPs as ID
source.verification: Transcribed from the supplied report; website checks do not rerun models or certify scientific validity.

suites.sample_design: 1,000 tables per split; 500 mechanisms, two independent tables per mechanism; n=500. Same observed tables and truths across methods. All evaluations succeeded.
suites.aggregation: Within each split, equal weight per DGP configuration, then per mechanism and replicate. Variances and squared errors are pooled before square roots. Aggregates are copied from Tables 2–3, not recomputed from rounded detail rows.
suites.variance_note: Reported SE is the square root of weighted mean within-mechanism sampling variance, estimated from pairs of independent tables. Display Variance ≈ (rounded reported SE)²; not an exact raw variance. Original SE is retained.
suites.variance_definition: Weighted mean within-mechanism sampling variance, reconstructed approximately by squaring rounded report SE; not cross-table error variance.
suites.split_definition: Operational labels: ID = 10 collected reference configurations; OOD = 3 structural shifts. These labels do not establish membership in official checkpoint pretraining; S01/S02 share source publications with ID configurations.
suites.hardware: CausalPFN: four persistent workers on four NVIDIA L40 GPUs. RF: 64 single-thread CPU processes on a server reporting 224 cores.
suites.timing_scope: Per-table warm point-plus-interval wall time, including preprocessing, auxiliary fitting and RF B=100 bootstrap. Excludes model loading, warm-up, data generation, disk I/O and queue waiting. Different hardware/concurrency; no matched-hardware speedup.
suites.generator_scope: 13 adapted low-dimensional literature configurations, covariate dimension 2–10. ATE integrates the conditional contrast over the DGP covariate law, not the empirical covariate average.
suites.coverage_note: 95% nominal intervals. CausalPFN ATE coverage is 76.83%/78.61%; RF is 98.66%/98.60%. No widening, trimming or post-hoc calibration.
suites.comparison_note: Frozen released CausalPFN versus two-fold cross-fitted AIPW with RF nuisance models; RF uses B=100 whole-row percentile bootstrap. No same-CPU paired timing experiment.
suites.context_note: ID/OOD are operational reference/shift labels, not verified checkpoint-pretraining membership. Variance is an approximate squared-SE conversion, not cross-table error variance.
suites.display_note: Original outcome units · Variance ≈ (reported SE)² · DGP-balanced aggregation · CausalPFN GPU / RF CPU timings are not matched-hardware.

suites.label: Proximal v3 · normalized (primary)
suites.target: CATE(x) = E[Y(1) − Y(0) | X=x], one query per task

source.title: Proximal ID10 Bootstrap evaluation — v3
source.verification: Transcribed from the supplied report; website checks do not rerun models or certify scientific validity.

suites.sample_design: 1,000 ID10 + 1,000 OOD tables, n=500; two methods on identical observed tables/queries. All 4,000 calls valid. 335 complete OOD pairs and historical times reused; 1,665 pairs newly called.
suites.aggregation: Equal weight per valid task; all tasks valid, no post-hoc deletion. Pooled OOD metrics are transcribed from pages 9 and 11. Pooled OOD variance and time are not printed; left unreported rather than reconstructed from rounded family rows.
suites.split_definition: ID10 = support-restricted/reweighted official activation subfamilies, not the exact training mixture. OOD = Cui linear bridge (343), Qi quadratic (321), Qi trigonometric (336).
suites.hardware: Shared CPU: 16 workers, one Torch/BLAS thread per worker; RF n_jobs=1.
suites.timing_scope: Full point-plus-interval computation, including RF B=200 refits. Excludes load/init, warmup, NPZ input, DGP/oracle and common result/checkpoint I/O. Historical 335-pair timings retained, not claimed remeasured.
suites.generator_scope: Frozen ProximalFM native distribution and a custom RF proximal bootstrap baseline, not a replication of published P-learner(RF). ID uses K=4096 Monte Carlo reference CATE; OOD uses analytic reference CATE.
suites.coverage_note: Native equal-tail credible intervals and RF percentile bootstrap assessed against reference CATE. Nominal 95%; pooled coverage does not replace family diagnostics (Qi quadratic PFM: 86.3%, Softplus ID: 88.5%).
suites.comparison_note: All attempted tasks retained. Normalization changes cross-task risk weights; original-unit results are available as a separate evaluation view.
suites.variance_definition: Cross-task Var((estimate − reference CATE) / sample SD(Y)), ddof=1; not repeated-sampling variance at a fixed mechanism.
suites.variance_note: Bias, RMSE and interval length are normalized by each table’s observed Y sample SD before aggregation. Variance is the sample variance of normalized errors. Pooled OOD variance was not printed; no estimate is invented.
suites.context_note: PRIMARY VIEW: each table is normalized by its own observed SD(Y). Variance is normalized cross-task error variance. Pooled OOD variance/time are not reported; see the per-family table.
suites.display_note: Normalized error/length metrics · cross-task error variance · Coverage and seconds unchanged · pooled OOD variance/time not reported.
suites.dgp_note: Page 8 gives six metrics for OOD families. Page 10 supplies only RMSE, coverage and length for ID subfamilies; missing cells are not imputed.

suites.target: Population ATT in an adapted two-period panel

source.title: PFN-DiD: third experiment — Reverted DGPs, training protocol and evaluation
source.verification: Transcribed from the supplied report; website checks do not rerun models or certify scientific validity.

suites.sample_design: 1,000 ID + 1,000 Source-OOD tables, n=500, one table per mechanism. All five runs use the same tables; S1/S2 are separate trained models, not independent data replicates or an ensemble.
suites.aggregation: Equal weight per test table within each split. Overall rows are transcribed, not recomputed from rounded DGP rows.
suites.variance_note: Cross-table sample variance of ATT estimation errors, denominator M−1. It mixes sampling variability with mechanism differences; one table per mechanism cannot estimate within-mechanism sampling variance.
suites.variance_definition: Cross-table variance of estimation errors, ddof=1; not within-mechanism sampling variance.
suites.hardware: Neural methods: shared MTT S5000 / MUSA GPUs. RF: eight CPU workers, one thread each.
suites.timing_scope: Mean per-table inference includes preprocessing, transfers/synchronization and all nuisance folds/DR scoring or RF fitting. Excludes file reading, model loading and independent warmup. Different hardware/concurrency; no matched-hardware speedup.
suites.split_definition: Source-OOD = three generator families excluded from adapter training/validation. Upstream TabPFN pretraining exposure is unknown.
suites.generator_scope: Adapted scalar two-period ATT tasks. Ye, truncated, mixture and Zhou added-covariate extensions were reverted; other adaptations remain. This is not a complete synthetic-control benchmark.
suites.comparison_note: DirectATT S1/S2, PS/OR-DR S1/S2 and RF-DR-DiD retained separately. RF uses an analytic no-covariate path when applicable. No RF bootstrap or causal-forest comparison was run.
suites.coverage_note: 95% nominal. DirectATT OOD coverage is 74.9%/75.1%; no post-hoc interval calibration. Mechanism-specific repeated-sampling coverage is not measured.
suites.context_note: Each training seed is a separate result. Variance is cross-table error variance, not the paired-mechanism SE convention used in ATE/CATE/Mediation.
suites.display_note: Original units · cross-table error Variance (ddof=1) · equal table weights · seeds kept separate · unmatched GPU/CPU timing.
